title: The four types of content
direction: Vale style: educational and premium. Teach the four content types clearly, with one big moment.

look.scheme: Monochrome (warm off-black, warm white, logo cream key word, film grain)
look.captions: Tom: Helvetica Neue Bold, lowercase, 1 to 2 words, white with a soft shadow, key word in logo cream
look.sound: Voice chain to -14 LUFS. Soft click, breath of air, short whoosh and film click (all synthesised, all kept in Style Lab)
look.check: Your white tee: captions sit between chin and logo with a deeper shadow. The cream key word is faint on white, so say if it should go.

frames.text: what should I film this week?

do: Opens straight on the speaker, no intro.
A light prompt bar drops into the top band at 0.8 s and types the question.

rows.sound: Soft click as the bar lands

do: Captions on the speaker, then a hard cut to the card on "big picture" (raw 9.2 s).
The words rise in (smooth rise). Back to the speaker on "than get caught up".

rows.card: Monochrome, Helvetica Bold lowercase 150px (r1-c1), smooth rise (r1-b2)
rows.sound: Breath of air into the card

do: Hard cut to the card exactly on "four" (raw 22.1 s), held until "types" ends.
Split opens: speaker below, the four types listed in the panel above.

rows.panel: Numbered list (r2-m4) in the monochrome split (r2-s1)
rows.sound: Soft click as each step lights

do: 04 Trending lights on "trending". The split closes on "happening".
Cut: the abandoned start "and I think if you can" (raw 56.7 s) is removed.
Captions on the speaker, then a hard cut to the card on "easier" (raw 65.5 s).

rows.sound: Short whoosh peaking on the cut (r3-b1)

do: Cut to the paper card on "especially". The note lands word by word (r3-h4).

rows.card: Blue ink on paper, signed "— vale studio"

do: Back on the speaker. Captions throughout, "education" in logo cream.

frames.title: New application
frames.body: Jess: love your team's videos. Are you hiring?

do: A notification slides into the top band on "attract better talent".
The longest stretch on the speaker. Captions only, no graphics, so the point lands.
The 6 s pause before this line is cut.
Cut to the month calendar on "planning". The days fill in to 30 as the line ends, and the video ends on the full month.

rows.sound: Breath of air, soft click on the last day
